about: Exact-file reads under the scoped read service (coven#857). Paths and grants are lexical; filesystem cases build a tree under a scratch directory with sibling folders root/ and outside/, bind root/ as the project root, and may change the tree at one step of the read. Every outside or protected file holds the word SENTINEL, and no successful read may return it. In the requests and filesystem sections a scope is written `<access>:<path>` for a non-recursive project scope, with a `recursive-` or `workspace-` prefix for the other forms; a filesystem request is a project `read_file` of the path in `request`, unless `operation`, `requestRoot`, `after` or `pattern` say otherwise. A listing expects its entries as `[name, kind]` and its `next`; a search expects its matches as `[path, line, text]`, its `next`, `skipped` and `complete`. A race step may name an occurrence, such as `opened#2`. An expectation with `filesystem: false` must refuse before any filesystem access, and one with `lastStep` must stop at that step of the read, so a refusal named as happening before an open really does.
